national.denominator_note: Primary: non-tower (n=205,783). All-assets (n=2,827,591) shown for sensitivity per Risk #1 R1.9. Flood metric: any_flood_exposed (FEMA SFHA ∪ SLOSH Cat1 ∪ HTF Minor ∪ SLR 2050), DATA v1.0.0; national % from county_master_v9_anyflood weighted average. Flood CI [4.17, 4.34] is SFHA-component bootstrap (conservative lower bound; anyflood CI pending). any_5h and multi CIs are SFHA-based bootstrap (pending anyflood resampling). EQ/WFPI/Hurricane/Winter: bootstrap CIs B=1000 state-stratified asset-level resampling; design effect from county clustering not fully absorbed — intervals are lower bounds. Spatial-cluster bootstrap is Risk #2 backlog.

hazard_svi_or.caveat: Sensitive to SE coastal coverage; EP_AFAM 2x2 a=222 b=1336 c=6 d=1508 → OR=41.5 is a STRUCTURAL geographic confound (coastal SE overlaps the historical Black Belt). Rule 4 — NOT a causal race claim. Dropping top quartile of EP_AFAM counties reduces OR substantially while preserving positive direction.
Does NOT survive Bonferroni m=87 (cutoff 5.7e-4); fisher_p=0.019.

Inverse direction is uniform across all four sub-themes — reflects geographic concentration of high winter SWE in lower-SVI northern states. NOT explained away per Rule 4. Survives per-NERC-region stratification within WECC.
